mentions.name: SuddenlyCards
mentions.description: A collection app that bundles many standard playing card games (Solitaire, Hearts, and others) with no subscriptions or ads, including P2P online play through a simple service that connects players, plus bot opponents built from heuristics for some games and small neural nets for others.
mentions.problem: Standard playing card games that used to come with computers have become enshittified with subscriptions, ads, and pesterware that the author's family was playing.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I'm making one app that has all the games I can think of without any of that crap. https://suddenlycards.com
mentions.author: furyofantares
